legal.terms.intro: TilePier is free software that runs on your own device. These four points are everything worth saying up front.
legal.terms.no_warranty.head: No warranty
legal.terms.no_warranty.body: The software is provided as is, with no guarantee of any kind — including whether it is fit for any particular purpose. This is the spirit of sections 15 and 16 of the GPL-3.0, the licence the source is under.
legal.terms.personal_use.head: Personal use
legal.terms.personal_use.body: The instance at tilepier.win is for personal use. The source is open, so if you need it for something else, run your own.
legal.terms.fair_use.head: Fair use
legal.terms.fair_use.body: The hosted instance fetches data through a rate-limited proxy. Automated access at scale will be blocked — not to punish anyone, but because the quotas behind it are finite and shared.
legal.terms.discontinue.head: It can stop
legal.terms.discontinue.body: The hosted instance may change or shut down at any time. Your data lives on your device, so that takes nothing away; even so, export a copy if you want to be sure.
legal.terms.licence_note: The source is released under GPL-3.0-only.
legal.privacy.intro: TilePier collects nothing about you. This is all there is to say.
legal.privacy.no_tracking: No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, no ads, no cookies.
legal.privacy.local_only: Everything personal — your layout, notes, todos, events, playlists, music files, saved places — lives in your browser's storage on your device.
legal.privacy.proxy: Network requests go through TilePier's own /api proxy. It holds no user identifiers, keeps no logs of its own, and caches only the public data payloads themselves. Cloudflare, as the infrastructure provider, processes requests under its own policies.
legal.privacy.coordinates: Coordinates are rounded to roughly 1 km before they leave your device. Searches — place names, ticker symbols, RSS addresses — necessarily pass through the proxy to be answered, and are cached anonymously.
legal.privacy.bug_reports: Bug reports are sent by you, and you review the contents before sending. Nothing is sent automatically.
legal.privacy.deletion: Deleting your data means clearing browser storage, or pressing "erase all data" in settings.

about.title: About
about.what_is: TilePier is a deck of widget tiles that runs entirely in the browser on your own device. No accounts, no sync, no server holding your data. You arrange the deck how you like and it stays that way.
about.limitations.title: Known limitations
about.limitations.layout: The layout is stored once, not separately per screen width. Rearranging on a narrow screen overwrites the arrangement you had.
about.limitations.tabs: Two TilePier tabs at once is fine, but the last write wins. Layout and settings sync between tabs; database contents only refresh on reload.
